narrative.details:
adventurer, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
